title: Playboy November 1986 Devin DeVasquez | Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a complete issue of Playboy magazine from November 1986 featuring model Devin DeVasquez with the centerfold included. The magazine is in English and was published monthly in the United States. It falls under the genre of women's content with a focus on modeling. The publication is illustrated and includes various articles, interviews, and pictures related to the topic of modeling.
